Welcome Package Breakdown

New members registering at SpinKong can activate a full welcome bundle covering their first four deposits, reaching up to £1,000 plus 250 Free Spins:

  • First Deposit: 120% deposit match up to £200 + 100 Free Spins.

  • Second Deposit: 100% deposit match up to £300 + 50 Free Spins.

  • Third Deposit: 80% deposit match up to £250 + 50 Free Spins.

  • Fourth Deposit: 100% deposit match up to £250 + 50 Free Spins.

To activate each welcome tier, a minimum deposit of £20 is required. Wagering requirements are set at 35x for bonus funds before cashouts are enabled.

Kong’s Daily Boost

Every single day, active players at SpinKong Casino can claim 50 Free Spins on designated slots by making a daily qualifying deposit of £25 or more. This offer resets every 24 hours, giving returning members consistent added value.

High-Roller Bonus

Players who prefer larger stakes can make use of our specialized High-Roller Deposit Match. Depositing £200 or more unlocks a 50% match bonus up to £1,000, tailored specifically for high-limit slot and table play.

SpinKong Royal Club Loyalty Program

Loyalty is systematically rewarded at SpinKong. Every wager placed on our games earns loyalty points that help you progress through the VIP tiers of the SpinKong Royal Club. Higher tiers unlock benefits like personalized weekly cashback, higher withdrawal limits, dedicated account managers, and tailored deposit incentives.

Mobile Application

SpinKong offers seamless mobile access across smartphones and tablets without requiring downloads from official application stores. Rather than using native installations, Casino SpinKong uses fully optimized web software that runs smoothly inside any standard mobile browser like Safari or Chrome.

To access SpinKong instantly from your phone, you can create a direct home-screen shortcut:

  1. Open your device’s browser and navigate to the official website.

  2. Tap the browser menu options.

  3. Select Add to Home Screen.

This shortcut places an icon on your device that opens SpinKong in a clean, full-screen view. The mobile platform retains full functionality, including HD live streaming, responsive slot layouts, full banking controls in GBP, and access to live chat support.

Why Choose SpinKong? Strengths & Things to Know

To help you decide if our service matches your preferences, here is a concise overview of our core features:

Advantages

  • Extensive Library: Over 3,000 slots, table games, and live dealer options.

  • Flexible Banking: Supports localized GBP deposits alongside secure cryptocurrency transfers.

  • Lucrative Welcome Package: Multi-tier bonus structure offering up to £1,000 + 250 Free Spins.

  • Fast Cashout Processing: Crypto and e-wallet withdrawals are processed with minimal wait times.

Considerations

  • Account Verification: Verification documents must be submitted before your first cashout.

  • Wagering Rules: Active bonuses require completing specified turnover requirements before funds unlock.

Verification and Account Security

To fulfill anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and maintain regulatory standards, SpinKong Casino operates a standard Know Your Customer (KYC) verification procedure. This process protects both our platform and your account from identity theft and fraud.

Verification is required before processing your first withdrawal request. You will be asked to upload legible copies or photos of the following documents in your account settings:

  • Proof of Identity: A valid passport, national ID card, or photocard driving license.

  • Proof of Address: A utility bill, council tax statement, or bank statement issued within the last three months displaying your full name and current residential address.

  • Proof of Payment: A screenshot of your e-wallet account or a masked photo of your payment card (showing only the first 6 and last 4 digits).

Our compliance team reviews submitted documents within 24 hours. Once verified, account limits are unlocked, enabling fast and unrestricted cashouts.

mainEntity.name: How do I register an account at SpinKong Casino?

acceptedAnswer.text: Click the Register button at the top of the homepage, fill in your email address, create a secure password, select GBP as your preferred currency, and complete your basic personal details.

mainEntity.name: What is the minimum deposit amount at SpinKong?

acceptedAnswer.text: The minimum deposit amount at SpinKong Casino is £10 for e-wallets and cryptocurrencies, and £15 for Visa and Mastercard payments.

mainEntity.name: How fast are withdrawals processed at Casino SpinKong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cryptocurrency and e-wallet withdrawals are processed within minutes after approval. Bank transfers and card payouts typically take between 1 and 3 business days depending on your bank.

mainEntity.name: Can I play games for free at SpinKong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most slot games and automated table games at SpinKong offer a demo mode. This lets you practice game mechanics using virtual credits before wagering real GBP.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I forget my login password?

acceptedAnswer.text: Click the Forgot Password link on the login screen, enter your registered email address, and follow the instructions sent to your inbox to reset your password.
